**Publish gate report: search ad**

**Going out:** Search ad (headline + description), UK, Pebblebrook Tea Co.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Organic Loose Leaf Tea" | Supported by Soil Association certification (certificate on file, renewed 2026). Loose leaf is a product fact. OK. |
| "Loved by 50,000 tea drinkers" | **Unproven.** Not on the policy list. The only figure on file is 1,200+ reviews. Invented customer count, so it must go. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On the policy list, exact wording. OK. |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list, exact wording. OK. |

**Regulated claims:** Nothing on health, money, legal, environment, children or pricing beyond the supported delivery threshold. No false urgency.

**House style:** No banned words or AI tells. Tone is plain. "Loved by" is also a soft superlative-style claim that rests on the unsupported number. Passes once the number is removed.

**Disclosure:** Our own paid search ad is marked by the platform. No extra label needed.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
- Removed "Loved by 50,000 tea drinkers".
- Optionally replaced it with the supported review claim, worded exactly as in the policy.

Suggested description:
> Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

Check that this fits the character limit for the description line. If not, drop the rating and use only the two other claims.

**Needs a decision**
- Is there a real source for 50,000? If it exists, send it so it can be added to the policy and logged. Until then, it stays out.

**Evidence log rows**
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad | Certified organic by the Soil Association | Supported | Policy §2
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad | Free UK delivery on orders over £25 | Supported | Policy §2
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad | Loved by 50,000 tea drinkers | Unproven, removed | None
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad | Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | Supported, if used | Policy §2, export Oct 2026

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Not approved yet. I haven't recorded any approval, and the revised copy needs Sam's explicit yes before it goes live.
